item.title: About Me
item.description:
Academic Profile

I am a Data Science researcher with a solid foundation in Computer Science and Engineering. My academic journey centers on developing machine learning and artificial intelligence solutions tailored to real-world impact, particularly within healthcare analytics and predictive modeling.

I hold a Master of Science (MSc) in Computer Science and Engineering with a major in Data Science from Daffodil International University. I earned my Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Computer Science and Engineering from Daffodil International University with a GPA of 3.54.

Postpartum Mental Health Screening Model

Research Area: Healthcare Analytics & Predictive Modeling

Technologies: Python, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, Pandas, NumPy

item.title: Research Focus
item.description:
Core Research Topic

Machine Learning-Based Multiclass Prediction of Postpartum Mental Health Conditions

Postpartum mental health screening remains a critical area in clinical decision-support systems. This research investigates robust supervised machine learning models to classify maternal health data into distinct screening categories:

  1. Normal
  2. Baby Blues
  3. Anxiety
  4. Postpartum Depression

Academic Note: This research presents an analytical screening and decision-support tool meant to assist clinical data interpretation. It is not intended to diagnose patients directly.
